# oc-recall

Purpose: search past OpenCode sessions by conversation text, locally and offline.
Language: Python 3.9+, standard library only. No network, no models, no keys.

Install:
  git clone <repo> ~/.config/opencode/skills/oc-recall && cd $_ && ./install.sh

Setup (first run on a machine):
  python3 scripts/oc_recall.py --setup        # dirs, dictionary, index, hourly updater

Search:
  oc-recall "cheap flight with a layover"
  oc-recall -n 10 --json "разбор бюджета по категориям"
  oc-recall -d ~/src/project --days 30 "refactor the api layer"

Data stays outside the repository:
  index      ~/.local/share/oc-recall/index.db
  dictionary ~/.config/oc-recall/synonyms.json
  source     ~/.local/share/opencode/opencode.db (read-only)

Files:
  scripts/oc_recall.py   CLI, indexer, search
  scripts/agent.py       updater (launchd, systemd timer, cron line)
  tests/                 73 offline tests + bilingual ranking benchmark
  references/design.md   measurements and scoring model

Limitations: lexical matching by default, so a paraphrase with no shared words needs
the optional embedding mode;
OpenCode only; the TUI session picker is not replaced.
